title: Iterate exact mutations of rank-three quivers

source.citation: Boundedness criteria for real quivers of rank 3, arXiv:2505.16955

translation.notes: The source’s alternating rank-three mutation recurrence is instantiated at `(p,q,r)=(3,2,1)`. Exact skew matrices certify every state, the Markov constant stays 8, and the growing weights exhibit the stated unbounded behavior.
